description: This PHP migration script defines a class GoteoSdg that manages database schema changes and data seeding related to SDGs, footprints, social commitments, spheres, and categories for a project. It includes methods for pre- and post-migration logic, SQL for schema updates, and data initialization in multiple languages.

classes.name: GoteoSdg
classes.description: Migration class handling database schema updates and data seeding for SDGs and related entities.

methods.name: postUp
methods.description: Performs data seeding for SDGs, footprints, social commitments, spheres, and categories in multiple languages based on current language setting.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to perform schema updates and create tables for SDGs, footprints, and their relationships.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to revert schema changes and drop related tables.
